subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should this issue remain open for a bounded profile that attributes repeated CA reads or parsing to an OpenClaw-owned stack?
rationale: The proposed optimization is based on a premise that conflicts with the documented startup architecture and Node contract, but a representative runtime profile could reveal a different OpenClaw-owned repeated path.

options.title: Request bounded profiling
options.body: Ask for a CPU or synchronous-I/O trace showing repeated certificate reads or parsing, connection counts, and the responsible stack before authorizing code work.

options.title: Close as unsupported
